frame.origin: Intersection of nominal run and stem axes

status: Estimated purchased-part references for arrangement studies, not production printed parts

neofit_product.role: Manufacturer-brand listing, topology and product photograph

neofit_drawing.role: Manufacturer-brand Branch Tee Union drawing, ATBU444 row; listed downloads on product page

jg_product.role: Requested product and photographs identify the perpendicular-stem geometry

jg_drawing.collet_state: Released/pressed, per starred dimensions on drawing

jg_other_drawing.role: Naming cross-check: page 2 contains CI530808W run-stem drawing, despite front page CI580808W label; not used for perpendicular-stem dimensions

local_jg_scan.role: Scanned physical polypropylene tee; contextual socket family and collet motion only. Its larger collar and physical insertion depth are not transferred to either acetal tee.

local_neofit_reducer.role: Separate NeoFit catalog part shares published 21.006 mm stem length. Family cross-check only; no scanned geometry transplanted.

local_neofit_flow_control.role: Its 13.7 mm collet dimension is an estimate, not scan evidence; direct part drawings supply these models’ collar dimensions.

neofit_dimension_interpretation.issue: Diagram labels E as half-run reach and L as axis-to-tip, while table instead provides H and L with values inconsistent with those arrows. H1.370 and L1.583 are interpreted as overall branch height and overall run span, respectively.
neofit_dimension_interpretation.basis: This yields collar Ø15.494, run span 40.2082, branch tip 27.051, shoulder 6.0452, and stem 21.0058: consistent with direct product photograph proportions, the separate NeoFit run-stem tee family (junction-to-tip 27.0002 and shoulder 5.9944), and the dimensioned JG perpendicular-stem envelope.
neofit_dimension_interpretation.confidence: Published values, interpreted axis mapping; around 1 mm envelope sensitivity is appropriate, not a measured tolerance.
neofit_dimension_interpretation.not_used: Shipping dimensions are not part dimensions; illustrative PDF line art is not assumed exactly to scale.

evidence.female_insertion: published on direct product drawing; transfer into another host is controlled by that host

evidence.stem_tip_y: inferred as total H branch envelope minus collar radius; drawing axis labels inconsistent
evidence.molded_steps_root_collet_and_tip_chamfer: photo-based visual approximation, not measured or scan fitted
evidence.internal_bore: illustrative Ø4.3 based on same-size JG family
evidence.scan_status: Neither purchased part has been scanned. Local scans inform family plausibility only.

mating.formula: For host insertion depth D and unit stem outward axis a: host mouth = stem tip - D*a. Stem shoulder remains stem_length-D outside the mouth; do not bury the entire stem.
mating.host_insertion_range_status: layout sensitivity range spanning measured resting-face physical JG tee depth and NeoFit published depth; not a manufacturing tolerance or guaranteed compatibility
